title: The Waist row target "Target <89" has no unit while the page shows "<89 cm"
evidence: Seen in the PR 1508 shots: the My health Waist row reads "Target <89" with no unit, while its value page reads "<89 cm". Still open. The other half is closed, not a bug: the vitals grid's amber Weight trend dash is the latest value's real grade tick (bt-status-warn, BMI 25.2 in the shot), drawn when there are fewer than two points for a sparkline; greying it would hide a real grade (found in PR 1571). (H83)
